vātaṃ vatsādanī hanyāt kaṃ kaṃḍīracitrakau? iti
tathā satiniṣattiktakaṃ, rasanendriyasya kiñcidudvejakaṃ tanmūlakopāṇāṃ haraṃ doṣaharaṃ nānyāvalyam
sarva bālaṃ, vṛddhaṃ ca mūlakaṃ śuṣkaṃ sat vātaśleṣmaharam
tathā āmakaphitya-kathanena tathāvidhāni kaṣāyāmlasvabhāvāni vi dhāni kaphityāni sadaivāmakaphityaguṇāni vedyāni pakvakaphityaguṇakathanena ca tathāvidhāni mādhu nuviddhāni sadā pakvaguṇāni vedyāni
tasya mātuluṅgasya kesaraṃ tatkesaraṃ—laghu tathā kāsādīn mandāgnitvaṃ ca nāśayet
pālevataṃ raivatakāsyaṃ dvidhā   kathaṃ dvidhākāramityāhaḥ—svādu, amlaṃ ca
tattu yathāsaṃkhyena śītamuṣṇaṃ ca   tathā dvayamapi guru, rucyamatyagniśamanaṃ ca
athavā yathāsaṃbhavaṃ saṃbandhaḥ   madhuraṃ gurvatyagnināśanaṃ ca
sarā sedinī tathā āyuṣe hitā   buddhirvartamānārthaprāhiṇī prajñā
vilvādīnāmupalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā   vilvābhirupalakṣitaṃ mahatpañcamūlaṃ kaphānilau jayet
śāstrakṛtā tu granthagauravabhattat spaṣṭaṃ kṛtvā noktam
dhātuḥ suvarṇādiḥ   mauktikaṃ muktā   kāṣṭhaṃ dāru
iyāvaṃ śuṣkamāsyaṃ mukhaṃ yasyāsau śyāvaśuṣkāsyaḥ śyāvaśuṣkavadanaḥ
kiṃ karoti vilakṣo vīkṣate diśaḥ   diśa iti samantādityarthaḥ
oṣṭhau leṭi   bhuvaṃ vilikhati   kriyāmu tvarate
ekāvarta iti   eka evāvarto yasya saṃhatasarvajvālatvādasau ekāvartaḥ
anarcirvā ajvāla iti vā   ugragaṃdhavāniti kuṇapagaṃdhavān
śuddhiratreṣṭā   atra viruddhāhāre kṛte vikāre śuddhirvamanavirekādirūpā iṣṭā śreṣṭhā
śamo veti   na kevalaṃ śuddhiriṣṭā śamaśceṣṭaḥ
kaiḥ   teṣāṃ vairodhikakopitadoṣāṇāṃ tatkṛtānāṃ vā visphoṭādīnāṃ vikārāṇāṃ virodhibhiḥ pratipakṣabhūtairauṣadhaiḥ
tena rātrāvapi jāgaraṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ divā tvāgreyamatyarthaṃ rūkṣaṃ kālenāhitabalatvāt
apiśabdābhyāmantareṇa tu rātrāveva jāgaraṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ, divā tu snigdhamityartho jāyate vyavacchedyaphalatvādvākyānām
nacaitadyujyate   tato divā jāgaraṇaṃ sadā rūkṣaṃ nābhaviṣyat
viṣārtaḥ kaṇṭharogī ca naiva jātu niśāsvapi
” iti   eṣāṃ hyapatarpaṇameva hitaṃ yaccāpatarpaṇaṃ tadavaśyaṃ rūkṣam
evaṃ ca pūrvameva vyākhyānaṃ yuktam   prasvaprajāgaraṇakriyayoradravyayorapi rūkṣasnigdhatvamupacārādupapattam
yathā—rūkṣaṃ dravyaṃ guggubbādi—kaphamedaḥ prabhṛtīn saumyān bhāvān kṣapayati tathaiva yadā jāgaraṇamapi tatkṣapayadṛṣṭaṃ tadā tadrūkṣakāryakaraṇādarūkṣamapi rūkṣamityupacayate
tathā prasvaprādarvāk kaphamedaḥ prabhṛtīnāṃ saumyānāṃ bhāvānāṃ svahetorūpādastathā nopalabhyate
yo mandanidraḥ sa kṣīrādīn śīlayet   kāntābāhulatāśleṣādayo nidrāsukhahetavaḥ
” iti   brahmacaryaratasyānugato maithunābhilāṣo nidrāṃ nāśayedityāha-grāmyasukhe niḥspṛhaṃ ceto yasya sa tasya tathā santoṣatṛptasya
mūrdhanakṣo 'bhighānaṃ ca tyajen   tathā-atyāśitādayaḥ surataṃ tyajeyuḥ
kaṣāyatiktaṃ mahatpañcamūlaṃ vātaṃ jayati, na tu pittamuṣṇa-vīryatvāt
te doṣāḥ ṣaṭ   ekasya kṣayaḥ ekakṣayaḥ dvandvasya vṛddhiḥ dvandvavṛddhiḥ
hemadri>arunadatta: yadvātādīn doṣān rasādīn dhātūn mūtrādīn malāṃśca kopayati tatkopanam
yathā—yavakapāṭalamāṣamatsyāmamūlakasarpapamaṇḍakadadhikilāṭaviruddhamatsyapayaḥprabhṛtidoṣādīnāṃ malaparyatānāṃ svapramāṇasthinānāṃ sāmyāttu vṛddhiheturyadravyaṃ tatsvasthebhyo hitam
vipākastrividhaḥ sarvadravyāṇāṃ pariṇāmakālabhāvī kāryānumeyo jāṭharāgnisaṃbaṃdhādrasasya svarūpāṃtaraprādurbhāvaḥ
sa ca kāryānumeyaḥ   tathā ca vakṣyati—‘jāṭhareṇāgninā yogādyadudeti rasāṃtaram
rasānāṃ pariṇāmānte sa vipāka iti smṛtaḥ
’ ata eva sopasargaḥ pākaśabda upāttaḥ   viśiṣṭaḥ pāko vipāko na pākamātrasvarūpaḥ

’ evaṃ karmaniṣṭhānumata ekarūpāvastho jāṭharāgnisaṃyogādyo rasānāṃ rasāṃtarodbhavaḥ sa eva vipāko na yo jāṭharāgnisaṃyogamātrādrasānāmanekāvasthaḥ prāṅmadhuro'naṃtaraṃ sa eva pacyamāno'mlastato vipacyamānaḥ sa eva kaṭuvipākaḥ
tāni ca lakṣaṇāni viparyayātyataviparyayābhyāṃ saha likhyante—kṛcchrādiṣūpayogāt

sarvoṣadhakṣamadehajatvam, auṣadhamātrākṣamadehajatvaṃ, yuvajatvaṃ, bālavṛddhajatvaṃ, atibālātivṛddhajatvaṃ, strīnapuṃsakajatvaṃ, garbhiṇīsūtikā—strīlakṣaṇanapuṃsakajatvaṃ, viṣayānāsaktendriyajatvaṃ, viṣayāsaktendriyajatvam, asadviṣayāsaktendriyajatvam, amarmagatvaṃ, prāṇaharamarmagatvam, alpanidānatvaṃ, bahunidānatvaṃ, yāvaduktanidānatvam, alpasaṃprāptitvaṃ, bahusaṃprāptitvaṃ, yāvaduktasaṃprāptitvam

heturnidānaṃ, saṃprāptiśca, alpapūrvarūpatvaṃ, bahupūrvarūpatvaṃ, yāvaduktapūrvarūpatvam, alparūpatvaṃ, bahurūpatvaṃ, yāvaduktarūpatvam, anupadravatvaṃ, sopadravatvaṃ, yāvaduktopadravatvam, utpādakadoṣāpekṣayā viparītadūṣyatvaṃ yathā—pittaje rasagatvam, atulyadūṣyatvaṃ yathā—pittaje raktagatvaṃ, tulyānekadūṣyatvaṃ yathā—pittaje raktasvedagatvaṃ, viparītadeśatva
yathā—kaphaje jāṃgalatvaṃ, tulyadeśatvaṃ yathā—kaphaje'nūpagatvaṃ, tulyadeśajanmatvaṃ yathā—kaphaje janmaprabhṛtisevitānūpagatvam, atulyatulya
yathā—vātaje śāradatvaṃ, tulyatulyaṃ yathā—vātaje grīṣmatvaṃ, tulyaprakopatulyaṃ yathā—vātaje vārṣikatvaṃ, viparītaprakṛtitva
yathā—pittaje kaphaprakṛtitvaṃ, tulyaprakṛtitvaṃ yathā—pittaje pittaprakṛtitvaṃ tulyāniyaprakṛtitvaṃ yathā—pittaje vātapittaprakṛtitvaṃ, vātasya yogavāhitvāt
pādasaṃpadbhāvatvaṃ, pādavikṛtatvaṃ, sarvapādavikṛtatvaṃ, anukūlagrahatvaṃ, pratikūlagrahatvaṃ, pratikūlasarvagrahatvam

atrāyuṣkāmarogānutpādanavādiśabdāḥ-āyuṣkāmīyarogānutpādanīyadravyadravyavijñānīyādīnāṃ lakṣakāḥ, dinatvīdādiśabdāḥ-dinacaryarthucaryādisaṃjñānāṃ vācakāḥ, śuddhayādayaḥśodhanādidravyaguṇāḥ, dṛkseka āśrotanaṃ kṣārāgnikarmakaeko'dhyāyaḥ, madādayo madātyayādayaḥ, viśi viḍogayoratīsāragrahaṇyoḥ, mūṣite mūtrarogayoḥ, kṛcchramedayoḥ bhūtagobhūtavijñānīyatapratiṣedhayoḥ, vartmasu vartmarogavijñānapratiṣedhayoḥ, saṃdhiṣu saṃdhigatarogavijñānapratiṣedhayoḥ, dṛgādiṣu trayaḥ, na tu pratyekaṃ sarvagādiṣu ṣaṭsu pratyekaṃ dvā vijñānapratiṣedhabhedāt, dvau vraṇau vraṇasadyovraṇabhedāt, sarvage sarvākṣiroge bhaṃge asthibhaṃge, granthyādiprabhṛtiṣu tripupṛthak, dvayaṃ vijñānapratiṣedhabhedāt
ityadhyāyasaṃgrahaḥ       iti hemādriṭīkāyāmāyurvedarasāyane adhyāyaḥ āyuṣkāmīyaḥ sāmastyena nirūpitaḥ
muhūrtasya ceha dvighaṭikopalakṣaṇārthatvātsarvasmin kāle rātreścaturdhaṭikāvaśeṣe samutthānaṃ kāryamiti sthitam
svastho nīrogaḥ kalpaḥ sa āyuṣo yathopacaritasya jīvitasya rakṣārthaṃ brāhme muhūrte uttiṣṭhedabhyutthānaṃ kuryāt
muhūrto nāḍikādvayam   brahma jñānaṃ tadarthamadhyayanādyapi brahma tasya yogyo muhūrto brāhmaḥ paścimayāmasya nāḍikādvayaṃ tasmin brāhme muhūrte uttiṣṭhet
rakṣārthamāyuṣo jīvitasya   tadā hyuttiṣṭhato vyādhyalakṣyādyabhāva evāyuṣo rakṣā bhavati
sa -ma hiṣyā idaṃ māhiṣaṃ kṣīramatyagnibhyo'nidreśca hitam
tathā garīyo gurutaram   tathā himaṃ tavīryam
vilepī grāhiṇī hṛdyā tṛṣṇāgnāṃ dīpanī hitā
sa  ityanayā diśā sarvaṃ peyādikaṃ pūrvoktaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ ca makṣyādikaṃ dravyeṇa kriyayā saṃyogena mānena cādiśet
tatra dravyato yathā   odanasya raktaśālyādijasya lāghavam
aparasya tvanyathātvaṃ dṛśyate   tathā coktaṃ taṃtrāṃtare
vṛṣyaṃ vātaharaṃ balyaṃ pathyaṃ śūlyāmiṣaṃ laghu apathyaṃ guru viṣṭaṃ māṃsaṃ yacca rasoddhetamiti taṃtrāṃtare coktam
yogaḥ saṃyogastena yathā   āgneyacitrakādyauṣadhakāthaiḥ sādhitasya lāghavam
tathā śrute gaditam   karīrakusumaṃ jñeyaṃ kaphapittaharaṃ laghu
snigdhasiddhaguṇānāha—snigdhaṃ ghṛtamāṃsādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ snigdhasiddhaṃ—yadoṣalaṃ mahadapi snigdhasiddhaṃ vātannaṃ kiṃpunaryadoṣadhnaṃ bālamityapiśabdārthaḥ
sa —sarva bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca mūlakaṃ śuṣkaṃ sadvātaśleṣmaharam
” iti   dvividhamapyatra grāhyaṃ guṇabhedāt, tebhyo jātaṃ phalaṃ sauvīravadaraṃ badarabhedau
maivaṃ, suśrutenāpi sauvīratulyamuktaṃ—“sauvīravadaraṃ snigdhaṃ madhuraṃ vātapittajit
” iti   sauvīravadaraṃ ceti dvandvaikatvaṃ pūrvatra tu kolaṃ ca tadvadaraṃ ceti karmadhārayāt viparītaṃ tu kṛto na syāditi cenna, saṃgrahe viśeṣaguṇoktau badarasaraṇātmakamiti badaragrahaṇāt
na ca badara—śabdena sauvīraṃ sauvīramityakaraṇāt saratvābhāvācceti

vātāmaḥ—snigdhamadhuramajjaṃ phalam, akṣoḍaṃ—madanaphalasadṛśaṃ madhyaṃ kiñcidunnatarekhaṃ, mukūlakaṃ—dantīphalasadṛśaṃ, nikocakaṃ—maṃkolaphalasadṛśaṃ, piyālaṃ—cāraphalaṃ, raktapittaprasādanaṃ—raktapittayornirmalīkaraṇam
āhāraṃ vināpi prayuktasya viṣasya śāntyarthamayaṃ yogaḥ syāditi viṣaśāntya ityuktam
saṃgrahe tu-īśvarāṇāṃ vasumatāṃ viśeṣeṇa tu bhūbhujām
prāyeṇa mitrebhyo'mitrā bhūyāṃso bhavanti, tatastatprayogātsamāsannavartino'nnapānādiṣu viṣaṃ prayacchanti, striyaśca tatpraṇidhiprayuktāḥ saubhāgyalobhena

tasmādvājā kulīnaṃ striyabhāttamāstikabhārye parigrahaṃ dakṣaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ, nirbhṛtaṃ, śucimanuddhatamanalasamavyasanamanahaṃkṛtamakopanamasāhasikaṃ, vākyāvabodhakuśalaṃ niṣṇātamaṣṭāṅge yathāmāyamāyurvede suvihitayogakṣemaṃ sannihitāgadādiyogaṃ, sātmyajaṃ ca prāṇācāryaṃ parigṛhītaṃ
tamarthamānābhyāṃ yathābhnāyaṃ saṃpradāyāntikrameṇa kālenukālaṃ gurumiva śiṣyaḥ pitaramiva putraḥ pūjayet

tasmāttadāyattabhāhāravihāraṃ prati cātmanaḥ kuryāt, upāttamapi khalu jīvitamupāyabalena svasamavāyamadhitiṣṭhati, api ca bahuparigrahā narapatayaḥ santi cāśukāriṇaḥ śūlasaṃnyāsādayaḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ pratyavekṣaṇīyāvasthāśca rogiṇo viśeṣeṇa rājānaste hi pramādaparigatā duḥkhāsahiṣṇavaśca, svayamapyapatharucayaḥ, sannihitāhitaprativacanaprāyaparivārāśca
tasmādbhiṣajo rājā rājagṛhāsanna eva sanniveśanaṃ kārayet, tathāhi—sa sarvopakaraṇeṣu nṛpatiśarīropayogiṣvaparokṣavṛttirbhavati
sa samyaksampannamannaṃ suparīkṣitaṃ, viśuddhamagnyādiṣu prāgupanītaṃ, śikhinā dṛṣṭamabhiprokṣitaṃ prokṣaṇaiḥ puraḥsthito rājānaṃ hastabaddhauṣadhiranaṃ bhojayet
tatra pracchāyadhātakīpuṣpajāmbavāsthiharītakīcūrṇaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ saptacchadakalkena vā pratisāraṇaṃ kuryāt
tatra sarpiṣpānaṃ yojyam   śrutena payasā saptakṛtvaḥ pippalīrbhāvayet
tatastatkalkena sarpirvipakvaṃ netratarpaṇaṃ kapitthameṣaśṛṅgībhallātakānāṃ puṣpairvaraṇaniryāsena cāñjanaṃ bṛhatīśirīpabījaprapauṇḍarīkanāgabalācūrṇaṃ saptakṛtvo madhunā bhāvayet
tacca sroto'ñjanasuvarṇacūrṇayuktamañjanaṃ nasyadhūmaprayukte śi rukkaphāstrāvaḥ khebhyo rudhirāgamanamindriyavaikṛtaṃ ca
ta tivipāśvetākākamācīmadayantikākalkakṣīrasiddhaṃ sa rnasye pāne ca vidadhyāt
veṇupatrikā dhikā   etānyeva ca sakapittharasagomūtrāṇi pānam
anena cāmaravyajane vyākhyāte   si 'bhyaṅgaprayukte vedanāgranthijanmakeśacyavanaṃ ca
ballī priyaṅguḥ   mūtrāṇyajāvihastinyo māṃsāni ruvirāṇi ca
bahuśo gālitaṃ tacca pācayettatra ca kṣipet
nāprāśitaṃ ca sūdādyaiḥ kiñcidāhārayentṛpaḥ dhanyaṃ sarvārthasiddhākhyaṃ pāpmarakṣoviṣāpaham

atha śuklapakṣe puṇye'puṣyapunarvasuhastacitrāmṛgaśiraḥśravaṇarevatīśatabhiṣakprājāpatyottarāṇāmanyatamena nakṣatreṇa yogamupāgate bhagavat ṣadhipatau praśaste muhūrte siṃdhusrotaḥsamutthaṃ snigdhaṃ sagandhavarṇacchedairnīlotpalābhamañjanamāharet
kālānusārya śaileyatataḥ śukle vāsasi baddhvā dvādaśarātramāntarikṣe'vāsayet
tato gajandhamāropya pāṇḍuracchatracāmaravālavyajanairanugataṃ tathā śadundubhisvanairdvijñātivaraprayuktaśca vedavādamimaiḥ puṇyāharṣa kṛtapuṣpopahāraṃ vaidyagṛhājāyakagṛhamanupraveśayet

anataraṃ ca tena videhādhipopadiṣṭena sarvārtheṣu siddhenājjanena yathoktānāmevājjanabhājanadravyāṇāmanyatamayā śalākayā gotrākṣaṇapūrvakaṃ śuciḥ saniyamo bhūtvā dhāriṇīmimāṃ vidyāmadhīyānaḥ pūrvamakṣi dakṣiṇamajjayet

namaścakṣuḥpariśodhanarājāya tathāgatāyāhate, asabhyakūsaṃbuddhāya tadyathā-cakṣuḥprajñācakṣuśānacakṣurviśānacakṣurviśodhaya svāhā tataḥparaṃ tāmeva dhāraṇāmanusaṃsmaran sāyaṃprātaḥ pratyahametatparamaṃ pavitramārogyakaramūrjaskaraṃ sarvavighnaharamajjanamaśvibhyāmindrasya vṛtravadhābhyutratasya prāvaprakalpitam
tasmādetadrājñāṃ rājamātrāṇāṃ ca mahīṃ vijigīṣamāṇānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vedādhyayanamanyadvā mahacchāstramavagāhamānānāṃ prasannamāno miṣak prakalpayediti, bhavanti cātra
yān sevamāno nṛpatiḥ śatrubhyo naiti vajranam
āḍhakī saurāṣṭrī   saviṣaṃ prokṣitaṃ tena sadyo bhavati nirviṣam
tataḥ kṛtvā maṇiṃ hemrā baddhaṃ hastena dhārayet
saṃsṛṣṭaṃ saviṣaṃ tena sadyo bhavati nirviṣam
śrutvā dṛṣṭvā tamāghrāya sadyo bhavati nirviṣaḥ
viṣaṃ bhuktaṃ jarāṃ yāti nirviṣe'pi na doṣakṛt
na tatra kīṭāḥ saviṣā nondurā na sarīsṛpāḥ
ajeyāmṛte viṣatantre   sarpikṣaudraṃ dadhi kṣīramantataḥ śītalaṃ jalam
antataḥ pūrvābhāntre ataeva pūrveṣu pūrvābhāve paramiti labhyate
vastrādi rājñaḥ sadṛśaṃ rājalīlāṃ ca varjayet
pāto yathā hi duḥkhāya nollāyaḥ sukhakṛttathā
upahāraṃ ca saṃdhyāyāṃ bhuktvā cānte niśāsu ca
saṃkṣepa eṣa viṣapālanasādhanāya proktastu vistaravidhiḥ punaruddhareṣu
ālocya samyagakhilaṃ matipūrvakārī yujjīta tatparikalayya vikāracihnam
iti viṣagararakṣo rakṣaṇāyopadeśaṃ bhajati narapatiryo nityamevāpramattaḥ
nijapararipuddhandairaprabhṛṣyo mahātmā sa janayati janānāṃ kṣemayogau cirā
sa  —amlaṃ dravyaṃ payasā saha sarvaṃ viruddham
anyathā payaso dravasamānajā tīyatvātkāṃjikādyeva dravadravyaṃ virudhyate na cukrikā dikamapi
tataḥ kiṃ sahaśabdena satyametat   sahagrahaṇaṃ tu niyamārtham
yadā tvamlena gorasādina kṣīraśākasaṃjñavyaṃjanakaraṇārthaṃ payaḥ saṃskṛtaye tadā tasya dravyāṃtaratvāpattervirodho nāsti
tathā dadhikṣīrādina ghṛtaṃ payyate tatrā'pyavirodha eva
api ca   kṣīre mukta uttare kāle'pyamlaṃ na bhojyamiti pratipādanārthaṃ ca sahagrahaṇam
phalaṃ tatheti   phalamakṣoḍādi ca payasā saha viruddham
sarvaśabdaḥ sarvatra na saṃbaṃdhanīyo yato na sarvaṃ phalaṃ payasā sahābhyavahatuṃ viruddham
api tu vadeva   tathā ca muniḥ parisaṃkhyayaivā'paṭhat
cuktikādikamityarthaḥ   anyathā payaso dravanajātīyatvāt kāṃjikādyeva dravadravyaṃ virudhyeta cuktikādikamapi
kiṃ sahaśabdena satyametat   sahamrahaṇaṃ tu niyam
